chapters.reason: The paper explicitly proposes a pretraining framework that mixes continuous concepts (learned via sparse autoencoders) into the model's hidden states, fitting the definition of latent-space pretraining.
The approach involves interleaving continuous hidden representations with token representations to enhance reasoning, which aligns with the concept of reasoning in latent space.
The paper evaluates the proposed framework on multiple benchmarks, specifically focusing on sample efficiency and reasoning performance improvements compared to standard methods.
